description: John Lienhard's asmeconf class v1.46 (2026/01/10, CTAN and MiKTeX package asmeconf, MIT licence), ASME's conference paper format as on ASME's conference pages: article at 10pt, twoside, two columns started by \maketitle, inline author names. The template's (colorlinks,upint,subscriptcorrection,varvw,hyphenate,balance,greek,russian,vietnamese,german) demonstrate features and languages. The class is written for pdfLaTeX and LuaLaTeX; XeTeX takes its non-pdfTeX branch with fontspec on (the nofontspec option is meant for LuaLaTeX), loading unicode-math and TeX Gyre Termes X, TeX Gyre Heros, Inconsolatazi4 and STIX Two Math by file name (asmeconf.cls l.652-705, all in MiKTeX). The preamble fills the header and the author line with the class's own commands, as the template does: \ConfName, \ConfAcronym, \ConfDate, \ConfCity and \PaperNo for the conference header (all optional), and \SetAuthors with one \SetAffiliation, since the class prints its own author list, not \author's. The class makes \date a footnote (\versionfootnote, l.2195) and \thanks do nothing (l.2184). nofontspec is now set: the XeTeX branch with fontspec loads texgyretermes-math, which fails on the runner, and calls the undefined \ClassErrorNoLine (l.664); with nofontspec the class leaves fontspec and unicode-math out (batch 2 probe).
preamble: \ConfName{Proceedings of the ASME International Mechanical Engineering Congress and Exposition}
